modify.feeInfoDesc:
A fixed modification fee of {fee} {currency} applies to any modification.
If the number of insured days increases, a pro-rata surcharge (based on the daily rate of the new plan) will be added to the total modification amount.
The new total plan price will reflect the new destination and duration.
